title: Team
subtitle: The people in this business, and what each of them can do.
readOnlyRole: Only owners and admins can invite people or change roles.
membersHint: Everyone who can open this business.
roleHintOWNER: Everything, including other owners and closing the business.
roleHintACCOUNTANT: Money, ledger, reports and approvals. Can't manage the team.
roleHintMANAGER: Tasks and documents. Money only if allowed below.
financeReadHint: Lets this person view accounts, transactions and reports, without changing them.
removeBody: They lose access to this business straight away. Their past work stays in the history. You can invite them again later.
pendingHint: Sent, but not accepted yet. Each link lasts 7 days.
inviteHint: They get an email with a link to join. If they don't have an account yet, they can make one from the link.
inviteSentBody: An email is on its way to {{email}}.
inviteLinkHint: You can also send this link yourself. It works only for that email address.
signInToAccept: Sign in, or create an account with the invited email, to accept the invitation.
acceptBody: You're signed in as {{email}}. The invitation must be for this email address.
useOtherAccount: Sign out and use another account
